definition: to cry out very loudly in fear
description: In a sunny park a group of young people play a freeze game on the grass. A man in a white t-shirt stands rigid with his eyes wide and his mouth open. A woman in black bounces towards the camera with her mouth wide open, crying out. Another man throws both hands up and shouts with his mouth wide open. The whole group then dances together on the lawn, one of them drops flat onto the grass, and the man in white cries out and laughs into the camera.

taps.target: the man in the printed T-shirt
